say:3:1421343001:1.text: Apologies, I didn't mean to startle anyone. I used the map Zanie left me to get here.
say:3:1421343001:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我无意冒犯，我是根据祖娅之前留给我的地图过来的。

say:4:1421343002:1.text: I wanted to contact you here in advance, but I didn't expect that there was someone else here.
say:4:1421343002:1.source_cn: 本来是想事先在这里与你们联络一下，没想到这里居然有别人在。

say:5:1421343003:1.text: The girl was saying something about rebuilding the empire or something like that... and then, she suddenly attacked me when she saw me.
say:5:1421343003:1.source_cn: 说什么重建帝国之类的……我刚一露面她就突然对我攻击。

say:6:1421343004:1.text: Thank you for subduing her, Indris.
say:6:1421343004:1.source_cn: 真是多亏你了，因度厄，幸好你把她制服了。

say:7:1421343005:1.source_cn: 所以，小丫头，你就是伊娜？

say:8:1421343006:1.text: You've bound my hands and feet, but you will never bind the technological prowess of the dwarves!
say:8:1421343006:1.source_cn: 哈！你们捆住我的手脚，但捆不住矮人智慧的光芒！

say:9:1421343007:1.text: I've already modified all the traps and mechanisms in here! And I just pressed the switch!
say:9:1421343007:1.source_cn: 这里所有的机关我都已经改造过了！我刚刚已经按下了开关！

say:10:1421343008:1.text: If you don't let me go, this whole place will explode!
say:10:1421343008:1.source_cn: 只要我不亲手操作，这里立刻就会爆炸！

say:13:1421343009:1.text: No, Inna! What should we do?! She's not one to lie. If she says so, this place will definitely explode.
say:13:1421343009:1.source_cn: 伊娜！你、你怎么……怎么办，这怎么办？！伊娜绝对不会吹...

say:14:1421343010:1.text: Let's die together in dignity and owner!
say:14:1421343010:1.source_cn: 我们同归于尽吧，为了尊严与骄傲——

say:15:1421343011:1.text: Ha! That's funny! You're going to try to blow up me and my friends with my materials in my own lab...?
say:15:1421343011:1.source_cn: 哈，可笑，在我的地盘，用我的材料，改造我的机关，炸我的人？
